rule: Hand labels. `text` is the problem; `program` names the LLM-style program the case runs (builders in backend/tests/geometry/test_regular_triangular_pyramid.py, frozen programs through the production route `verify_and_compile`, 0 model calls). `expect`: `served:<value>` (exact, the learner-visible value of the requested quantity) or `refused:<stage>:<reason_code>` where `*` leaves that field open; `cause` notes the mathematical reason. Expected values are derived by hand below and re-derived by diagnostics/oracle_rtp_w01.py from the stated data only (Fraction arithmetic on squares, no product code). Labels are not lowered after a result is seen; a change of scope is written as a dated amendment in this file. Rows with `program_fault: true` are determined by the text but run a program that realises something else; they must be refused because of the program, never served. Rows `U*` are outside the declared representation domain (ASSUMPTION_CERTIFICATE_AMENDMENT §18.2) and must be refused, never rounded.

derivations.volume: V = (1/3) · (√3/4) b² · h = b² h √3 / 12 for an equilateral base of side b and height h (apex above the centroid); V² = b⁴ h² / 48
derivations.height_from_lateral_edge: a base vertex is at the circumradius R from the centroid, R² = b²/3: h² = l² − b²/3
derivations.regular_tetrahedron: all six edges equal b: h² = b² − b²/3 = 2b²/3
derivations.representability: points must lie in ℚ³ (kernel). An equilateral triangle with rational vertices has side² = 2N·q² (N an Eisenstein norm a²+ab+b²; brute force |x|,|y|,|z| ≤ 4 gives side² ∈ {2,6,8,14,18,24,26,32}), never a rational square; its plane has a normal n with |n|² = 3d², so the apex height is a rational multiple of √3. Declared domain (§18.2): b² = 2k² or 6k², h² = 3t², k, t rational. In that domain V = b² h √3/12 is rational (b²=2k², h=t√3 ⇒ V = k² t / 2; b²=6k² ⇒ V = 3k² t / 2)

regression: the seven families already measured (triangular pyramid, rectangular pyramid, triangular prism, cuboid, cube, cross-section, regular square pyramid): backend suites incl. regular-square-pyramid-w01/w05 corpus (U3_regular_triangular stays refused), demo replay, browser suite at the measurement commit
